Message:
KVM/nVMX: Use kvm_vcpu_map when mapping the L1 MSR bitmap

Use kvm_vcpu_map when mapping the L1 MSR bitmap since using
kvm_vcpu_gpa_to_page() and kmap() will only work for guest memory that has
a "struct page".
